Marco: need to confirm utm + gclid forwarding. last mapping missed `utm_content`. Ill QA webhook.

Ivy: ops rules: disable auto-bid >10% increase during test; pacing smoothing 0.3; frequency cap retarget 3/day.

Tess: assets uploaded to drive and linked in campaign.

Marco: webhook test returned 200, gclid present in test stream. cohorts: holdback_v1, exposed_v1. dashboards queued.

Ivy: plan: Jules deploy canary by 4pm PT, monitor first 6h then scale to 35% if CTR up >=4% and CPL down >=10%. Post short updates here.
